fieldNotes.location: Confirmed via web search (4855 Greatland Dr, coords 29.472769,-98.396782) and satellite: large multi-building manufacturing campus with rooftop process equipment (silos, ducting, exhaust stacks), dock banks on multiple faces, and large trailer drop yard. Roster point landed on the building corner; locked center on the rooftop equipment cluster.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Plant is chain-link fenced (visible in 2024 Street View along the west/Greatland frontage). Truck/employee access funnels through a controlled fenced opening off the internal driveway; classified as a truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Street View shows a small structure beside the entrance fence opening near the plant facade; consistent with a guard booth but partly obscured by parked trailers and distance — medium confidence, flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks visible on the south building face (orange-cab Frito-Lay tractors backed in) and along the east face with many trailers backed in; aggregate clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 60-75+ trailers parked in rows on the east and southeast yard plus along internal drives; large dedicated drop yard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters on different building faces (south face and east face) indicate physically separated shipping/receiving.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of ~4 interconnected large buildings (manufacturing, warehouse, support).
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the SE perimeter in the adjacent corridor but no spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Northeast San Antonio industrial park near I-35 — Urban.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single combined in/out driveway estimated; lane count not clearly resolvable from imagery.
